fact_check_notes: The article does not infer margins for advertising, ecommerce or membership because Walmart does not disclose complete stand-alone economics for those activities.
Reported and adjusted operating income are kept separate; the GAAP 16% increase is not presented as underlying mix growth.
No current price, consensus estimate, quotation or unsupported forecast is included. Facts, management guidance and Compound interpretation are distinguished.
